articles.summary: Columbia Bank proudly announced the successful completion of its annual food drive, bringing employees from across the company together to support local families facing food insecurity this holiday season. Through company-wide collections and online giving, employees donated more than 3,500 pounds of food and essential items, along with more than $1,000 in cash, checks and gift cards, to support hunger relief organizations throughout the communities Columbia Bank serves.  "This year's food drive was a company-wide effort, and I want to thank every employee who took part," said Thomas J.
articles.title: Columbia Bank Employees Donate More Than 3,500 Pounds of Food and Essentials to Fight Food Insecurity
